channel.description: Essays on mathematics education, children’s mathematical thinking, teaching, learning, research practice, culture, and public scholarship.

item.title: Why the Way Children Think About Mathematics Matters
item.description: A correct answer tells us something. How a child arrived at it can tell us much more. A reflection on multiplication, children’s strategies, and what we can learn when we stop to ask, “How did you get it?”
